cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

cards.name: Shaymin
cards.description: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: White Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: It searches for food all day. It gnaws on hard objects to wear down its fangs, which grow constantly during its lifetime.

cards.name: Raticate
cards.description: With its long fangs, this surprisingly violent Pokémon can gnaw away even thick concrete with ease.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

cards.name: Farfetch’d
cards.description: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

cards.name: Ditto
cards.description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: When its belly is full, it becomes too lethargic to even lift a finger, so it is safe to bounce on its belly.

cards.name: Snivy
cards.description: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

cards.name: Togepi
cards.description: It transforms the kindness and joy of others into happiness, which it stores in its shell.

cards.name: Dunsparce
cards.description: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

cards.name: Taillow
cards.description: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

cards.name: Skitty
cards.description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

cards.name: Delcatty
cards.description: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.

cards.name: Spinda
cards.description: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

cards.name: Buneary
cards.description: By extending its rolled up ears and striking the ground, it can bound so high it surprises itself.

cards.name: Lopunny
cards.description: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won't notice a foe coming from behind.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: Though it is a very brave Pokémon, it's also smart enough to check its foe's strength and avoid battle.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: This very loyal Pokémon helps trainers, and it also takes care of other Pokémon.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: Being wrapped in its long fur is so comfortable that a person would be fine even overnight on a wintry mountain.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Males swing the plumage on their heads to threaten others, but females are better at flying.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Terrakion
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Altaria
cards.description: This extremely rare Pokémon is a different color than usual. It is very hard to find.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.description: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Numel
cards.description: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

cards.name: Camerupt
cards.description: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.description: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

cards.name: Darmanitan
cards.description: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

cards.name: Wartortle
cards.description: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

cards.name: Blastoise
cards.description: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

cards.name: Delibird
cards.description: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

cards.name: Bellossom
cards.description: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

cards.name: Cryogonal
cards.description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

cards.name: Keldeo
cards.description: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

cards.name: Electrode
cards.description: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

cards.name: Scyther
cards.description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.description: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.description: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Gothita
cards.description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

cards.name: Gothorita
cards.description: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

cards.name: Meloetta
cards.description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.

cards.name: Sandshrew
cards.description: It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger, it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

cards.name: Sandslash
cards.description: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it's stunned with surprise.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.

cards.name: Makuhita
cards.description: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

cards.name: Dwebble
cards.description: When it finds a stone of a suitable size, it secretes a liquid from its mouth to open up a hole to crawl into.

cards.name: Crustle
cards.description: When its boulder is broken in battles for territory, it feels unsure and begins to weaken.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.description: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Their cute act is a ruse. They trick people and steal their valuables just to see the looks on their faces.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: It makes a nest out of the bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Scizor
cards.description: It raises its pincers with eyelike markings for intimidation. It also swings them down dangerously.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speed of over 180 mph.

cards.name: Skarmory
cards.description: Its heavy-looking iron body is actually thin and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

cards.name: Flygon
cards.description: Known as "The Desert Spirit" this Pokémon hides in the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.
